title: Smart reports, surveys, and pooled group budgets for Claude Enterprise
summary: Three Claude Enterprise features are now generally available: smart reports, in-app surveys, and pooled group budgets. Smart reports sample transcripts and group workstreams to show spend, deliverables, and friction points, but are not meant for individual performance review. Pooled budgets add a shared monthly budget with alerts at 50/75/95/100%, individual limits still apply, and availability varies by configuration.

title: Claude Cowork and chat come together for Enterprise
summary: Chat and Cowork are now unified into one experience across web, desktop, and mobile, generally available for Enterprise. Quick answers and code or file tasks run together with no mode choice, with cloud work continuing after a laptop closes and resumable on any device. Admin controls include role access, model entitlements, spend limits, and pooled group budgets, and security relies on isolated VMs, egress off by default, and SSO and Compliance API coverage.

title: IDC brings Quanta into Claude and adopts Claude across the company
summary: The IDC Quanta technology intelligence platform is now available in Claude via an MCP connector, with answers citing IDC sources for market, competitor, and vendor questions. Example uses include competitor briefs, Excel vendor scorecards, and budget-versus-forecast comparisons. IDC also rolled out Claude company-wide, starting with engineering, where code reviews dropped from 5 days to about 30 minutes.

title: Expanding Claude for Nonprofits
summary: Claude for Nonprofits is a plugin of skills and connectors for verified nonprofits, built with about 30 nonprofits, covering marketing, hiring, board work, org setup, and fundraising. It builds on 25,000+ nonprofits already using Claude, mostly small teams under 10 seats, and Claude Corps plans 1,000 early-career fellows across 400+ US nonprofits. It installs automatically at no extra cost on Team and Enterprise plans.

title: Building agents: When to fold subagents into your main agent loop
summary: This guide explains replacing subagents with a single agent loop, where domain procedures become skills and mechanical checks become tools via tool search. Single agents often matched or beat multi-agent designs on quality at lower cost and latency, with one customer seeing roughly 2x faster runtime. Teams are advised to build a small eval, fold in one subagent at a time, and keep a subagent only if the score drops.

title: The full Claude Platform, available on Google Cloud
summary: Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) are now generally available with the full Claude Platform feature set, billed on a single Google Cloud invoice that counts toward existing Google Cloud commitments. New features and betas such as Managed Agents (beta), code execution, computer use, caching, and batch are available on the same day, and Fast Mode on Claude Opus 5.5 is GA with up to 2.5x faster output. The Google-managed option remains available for Google-as-processor, regional residency, and Model Armor.
